photos.c: John Thresher (10) and Geoff. North (9) in the muddy thick-of-it during the Fire Brigade '2' at White City on Sept. 18th. The six runners that surround them are Gibson, Tulloh, Jackson, Stewart, Johnston, and J. Cooke. Geoff. (8:51.0) won from Jackson with John 6th (8:55.4).
